reader_summary.overview: This time around, we'll discuss investing where capital is truly scarce - the frontier of the frontier markets. Kiyan Zandiyeh is the CIO of Sturgeon Capital. Our conversation covers Kiyan's early entrepreneurial and investing experience, venture and operating experience building two businesses in Iran through 80% currency devaluations.

key_points.text: Kiyan Zandiyeh is the CIO of Sturgeon Capital.
Our conversation covers Kiyan's early entrepreneurial and investing experience, venture and operating experience building two businesses in Iran through 80% currency devaluations.
We discuss Sturgeon's investment process across country selection, targets, founders, valuation, risks, and investment examples.
